verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a SaaS project-management platform, so SSO/SAML organization access is a fair axis to ask about. However, no evidence item mentions SSO, SAML, or identity-provider integration. The vague "simple and secure" workspace access line and the separate-workspaces feature are adjacent and earn no credit.
